reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to a 1–10 person business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, pragmatic tone, framing data residency as an operational workflow issue without any sales CTA.
reasons.clarity: Immediately establishes a clear main thesis, follows a clean logical progression, and explains workflow constraints in plain, unambiguous terms.
reasons.actionability: Provides a realistic, clearly scoped diagnostic exercise for an owner-operator: mapping where data lives in one recurring workflow before automating.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately references Bareni's tooling stack (Zapier, Make, n8n) and persona scenario without inventing customer results, metrics, or claims.
